title: Polytomic Failures by Sync
app: Polytomic sync run events via the Polytomic API/webhooks to HEC.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=polytomic:sync status="error"
| stats count as failures, latest(_time) as last_failure by sync_name
| where failures>0
| sort - failures
description: Counts Polytomic failures grouped by sync so operators immediately see which specific syncs are broken rather than a single global failure number.
value: Object-level failure attribution turns a vague 'Polytomic is failing' alert into an actionable list of exactly what to fix first.
implementation: Ingest Polytomic failure events; schedule every 15 minutes and alert on failures for business-critical syncs.
visualization: Table of sync by failure count and last failure time.
grandmaExplanation: We tell you exactly which parts of Polytomic are failing, not just that something is wrong, so the right thing gets fixed first.
